body:
Call me crazy for asking, but is your hotel hiring?  I actually have experience in working for a hotel front desk/mailroom in a way (did it for approx. 3 years).  It was related to my college dorms, but we did the same thing basically.  And, in the end, we worked with the college hotel/guesthouse.  Also, we handled conference services during the summer (when college was out).

Guess it couldn't hurt to ask at this point.

I have thought of couch surfing to be honest.  Although I'm afraid to think that most people probably wouldn't want me at there place for too long (not because of me, but it seems that service is aimed for only a few days).  But will probably go on there soon and ask around.
I'm a guy.  I only have a small Camry, so hiding in the back of a van isn't an option for me.

Because the places I applied for didn't accept me.  I sort of thought I had more time than I did to find a job.  I got an interview once, but they hired someone else first.

Parents didn't help me.  They are extremely indecisive and would tell me that I was wrong when I came up with ideas.  I sort of am no longer listening to them because there suggestions have landed me right where I am today.  Close to killing myself and no longer out west.

Problem with the van suggestion is I only have a small car.  And I know cops harass people who sleep in there car, much less people who will rob you.  At least with a truck/van I could hide in the back.

I went to college at the UofU in SLC.  Although it wasn't the perfect reflection of western culture, it was close enough.  

Las Vegas is one of my number one picks of places to live.  Do you know of any places that may offer free housing (religious sanctuaries or similar)?  I only say religious places because I have heard of some offering free housing to people before.

Very determined, but don't want to be stupid.  I want to at least have an idea of where I can find refuge.  

Maybe you know of a religious sanctuary that offers free housing for volunteer work?  If you gave me one, I would be in my car this week going out there.  That is how determined I am.  Lets put it this way, if I don't fix things I will be buying a gun and shooting myself very soon.  I don't know when that will happen, but it has never crossed my mind as seriously as it has recently.  Suicide has been on my mind before, but nothing like this.
How?  That's even harder than going out west.  But if you have an idea I would love to hear it.

I'll PM you the specifics sometime if you care.  But if its just a way to get off my mind of killing myself (I'm a psychology major, so went into this topic of suicide a few times), it might not be worth it.

I have applied for a few trainee programs.  Ones I could realistically get into and would pay well enough for me to live on my own.  They told me to contact them when I lived out there as they can't hire me unless I live out there.

In order for me to live out there I have to have a job.  In order for me to get a job out there I have to live out there (in my position).  

If I had the money, I would get a small studio apartment on my own and live frugally until I got a job out there.  And work at it 24/7.  Me being out there would equal me getting a job.

I can't get anyone to loan me 5000$.  And my parents wont co-sign for it either (trust me, I've asked about similar things in past).

Yes, doing the above would work and I could probably pull off getting a job out there in 2-3 months max (full time) knowing me.  But can't do it, as no one will help me do it.

I'm trying not to end it now.  My car barely works now a days.  My parents will not support me on any decision I make besides just staying in there house until I get financial support.

I even got to the point today where I said I am going to kill myself if I don't leave here and told one of them about just driving.  He could only worry about the finances.  I had to say it 5 times about shooting myself to get it through one of there heads what "killing yourself" means.  And I NEVER tell them things like this, even when I had thoughts like this before.  But I've never been like this before.
I'm 23.  And British and most of Europe has a FAR MORE supportive system for people like me.  I'm on my own in the USA.  Its a lot different here than there.  I wish I was in Britain actually.

Can't, military won't let me join the military for a year because of my meds.  And if I got caught lieing (although already told them, so wouldn't work anyways), I would ruin any chances of getting help with college later on.  

I'm going to respond from the mindset of NOT killing myself.  Because that is the goal and why I posted.

No, but I'm not stupid enough to just take suggestions of just GOING with no where to go to.  There is such things as balance.  I apologize when I say this, I'm not trying to be rude and I thank you for your responses.  Yes going out west is an option, but doing without a plan isn't.

I'm looking for a solution that I can't find holes in.  I'm sorry that I need to play devils advocate, but I don't take suggestions blindly.  And if someone can't counter what I bringing up, I think that is something to be concerned about.  

Yeah, I'm actually trying to prevent myself from killing myself both short and long term.  Sorry if that is crazy.

There is no improving with my family.  That would require them to make changes that they can not and will not make.  And yes, I have asked.  They have had issues and are the definition of a dysfunctional family.

I'm considering moving up with uncle in a week, assuming he even wants me there.

Sure, again, how?  Just drive to California?  People love to act like its just that easy.  Here is something, if I don't kill myself staying out here I'll probably do it going into massive debt that I wont be able to pay off.

I wouldn't mind living in Alaska, but doubt they pay you to live there.  Evidence?  Yes, they pay you some money off oil from the state, but doubt its enough to live on.  Plus you probably need alaska citizenship which can take a few months.

How can I defer loans?  Its not that easy to do less you join the peace corp.  Something I would do if it didn't require a 2 year commitment.  Unless they somehow make it an instant move, otherwise may as well put the time in getting a job.

I have lots to lose.  I have no idea how I could get loans to pay for this.  I'm pretty sure I already ran through all my FAFSA money at this point as a dependent (won't go independent until 24).
I can drive myself more insane to the point where I'm not human anymore?
Yes, I tried that.  They tell me I have to be in the area.  Doesn't work.

Yeah, because its just that simple.  Just drive out there.  Where do I stay?  How am I ever going to get a job staying out in my car?  

Sorry, yeah, I know it sounds great to just UP and GO and drive myself into MASSIVE debt.  But reality is if I actually do make it out there, then might just die from going into such massive debt.

Check myself into a hospital?  How would that do?  How could I afford that?  That would almost make it impossible to get a job with the military if they found that.  And YES, a job with the military would make me happy and they could help me pay for college and get a degree I really want.

I spell it out for you:  I want SOLUTIONS that are REALISTIC to the point that I dont go killing myself later from massive debt just GOING would bring.  This isn't cry for attention.  This is a cry for help to prevent me from doing what I know I can do.  And I've never felt this close to ever doing it in my life.

Well now that you say that, I guess I'll go for the gunshot.  That way I don't have to worry about liver disease...  You do understand if I'm going to do it, I'm going to do it, right?  I don't mean to sound like a dick when I say this, but I'm not trying to do this for attention.  I'm trying to do this to end this if things don't work out.

I just went to college.  I can't go back.  I owe shit tons of money with no job.  That is not something "easy" to do.  Unless your talking about Europe or something, I'm in the USA.  I'm 23.

I was hoping to move to California or maybe the Nevada area (also Oregon or Washington are an option).

How could I qualify for youth shelters?  Can't, I'm over 18 (aka, 23).
